about: Every published MyPaisa artifact and the repo files it is published from (MA-324; Arun, 3 Nov 2026: "All artifacts and design should be in sync with local"). A synced artifact is republished whenever its sources change, then recorded with `python3 scripts/artifacts_sync.py record <name> <version>`; `plan_sync.py check` fails while one is behind. A retired artifact and a dated design round kept as a record are listed, never compared.

artifacts.name: MyPaisa Prototype v5
artifacts.note: Kept as the record of the prototype Arun last walked (published 5 Nov 2026, MA-336), never republished: Arun, 23 Nov 2026, MA-301: "no need to update Prototype v5, just the ios-v1 and app-v1 and design system updates are all that is needed.. make it a rule" (.claude/rules/plan-sync.md, rule 5). It loads app-v1's shared files, which change after it; the published copy keeps the ones it was published with.
